theorems.name: Escauriaza-Seregin-Sverak (2003)
theorems.solution_class: Leray-Hopf weak solutions on R^3 x (0, T)
theorems.required_uniformity: Global whole-space spatial L3 norm uniformly bounded in time
theorems.time_requirement: Time interval up to potential blow-up time T
theorems.conclusion: No singularity can develop at time T (u remains smooth)
theorems.evidence_satisfying: Local scale-critical L3 velocity norm uniformly bounded on cylinders Q_R (norm ~ 0.5-1.0)
theorems.missing_assumption: Global whole-space L3(R^3) spatial control without mass loss at spatial infinity

theorems.name: Lei-Ren-Tian (2009)
theorems.assumptions: Exists fixed unit vector e in S^2 and delta > 0 such that |omega| <= M or |xi x e| <= 1 - delta
theorems.required_uniformity: Single common axis e across the space-time cylinder
theorems.conclusion: The space-time point (0,0) is a regular point
theorems.evidence_satisfying: Local strained shear layers exhibit theta <= 35 deg (|xi x e| <= 0.57, delta = 0.43)
theorems.missing_assumption: Isotropic multi-structure turbulence contains competing structures oriented along different axes; single global axis e fails globally

theorems.name: Constantin-Fefferman (1993) / Deng-Hou-Yu (2005)
theorems.solution_class: Smooth solutions on R^3 x [0, T)
theorems.assumptions: Direction xi is Lip_1/2 in space along vortex lines and |u| <= C (T-t)^(-gamma)
theorems.required_uniformity: Smooth direction continuity across high-vorticity region
theorems.conclusion: No finite-time blow-up occurs at T
theorems.evidence_satisfying: Directional coherence in localized sheets, low spherical dispersion
theorems.missing_assumption: Uniform Lipschitz continuity along trajectories during eigenframe rotation episodes

theorems.name: Koch-Tataru (2001) / Seregin (2012) Type-I Framework
theorems.assumptions: sup_{0 < r < 1} [ A(r) + E(r) + F(r) + D(r) ] < infinity on (-infinity, 0]
theorems.required_uniformity: Uniform supremum over all scales r in (0, 1) and backward time horizon T -> infinity
theorems.conclusion: Ancient limit is trivial or rigid
theorems.evidence_satisfying: Sampled A, E, F, D remain bounded (< 10) at discrete radii
theorems.missing_assumption: Continuum scale supremum gap (untested r -> 0) and finite numerical horizon T^- < infinity
